items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: we had Ernie Henry. Oh, we had a good group.

ctx.x: Which was -- we had Ernie Henry. Oh, we had a good group. We would change, you know, frequently. And I said, 'Oh, no, man, Diz, I can't make it.' So he said, 'Oh, don't be a drag, Klook, come on. Come on.' I said, 'No. I'm happy with Tadd, Diz, and you do your thing, and we're still boys. We'll always be friends, you know, as long as I live. But I don't -- I'm not in the mood to go to Europe. I just left Europe in the Army.'
